endpointEvidence.screenObservation: All four radio controls and option labels remain visible. Each table shows the complete union and intersection headers and their four data rows at the right endpoint. The left-hand columns are intentionally partly outside this endpoint window and remain covered by the original left-window evidence. Final table rows, closing notation, separator and blank bottom margin are visible.

tables.visualObservation: Both U union V and U intersection V headers are visible. The first-row union [max(a,b),+infinity) and intersection [min(a,b),+infinity) retain their full closing notation. The remaining union entries show the real-line symbol, the real-line symbol, and the full (-infinity,b] union [a,+infinity) expression. The intersection column shows [a,b], {a}, and the empty-set symbol in the final three rows. The bottom empty-set entry and final union closing parenthesis are not cut.

Both operation headers are visible. The first-row union [min(a,b),+infinity) and intersection [max(a,b),+infinity) are complete through their closing parentheses. All remaining union entries, including the final separated-interval union, are visible. The fourth-column entries [a,b], {a}, and empty set are complete; the last row stays clear of the following option.

The complete union and intersection headers and all four right-column rows are visible. First-row min/max interval expressions retain their closing notation. The two real-line union entries and final separated-interval union are intact. The intersection entries [a,b], empty set, and empty set remain distinct on their own rows. No final expression or bottom row is truncated.

Both operation headers and the complete first-row min/max intervals are visible. The remaining three union entries show the real-line symbol. The fourth column shows [a,b], {a}, and empty set without lost brackets or braces. The final empty-set row, separator, and bottom blank margin are intact. No union/intersection overlap is visible.
